summary: 2TOMS4 - BYGGLINJEFORENING (org. no. 918 528 644) is an association (FLI) based in Narvik, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2017-02-07. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Mariell Svendsen Haugnes.
